name: web-research
description: Research a topic on the web and return sourced findings with comparison.
steps: fetch 3+ primary sources for the question
compare claims across sources, note disagreements
summarize with source links and confidence per claim
validation: every claim cites a source link
failure_recovery: report which sources failed and summarize the rest
cautions: read-only browsing: never submit forms or log in anywhere
never download or execute files from the web
